title: Console: stale search index silently drops whole live console to fixtures
description: loadProjectSearchResults throws a ConsoleCliContractError when the search index is stale; live-data.ts rethrows it, so loadConsoleData's catch falls back to createFixtureConsoleData for the ENTIRE dashboard. The mode badge then reads 'fixture' but a casual user sees plausible demo data thinking it is live. Discovered while validating selection: bwrk raw list returned real data yet /api/state showed bw_source_fixture_* ids until 'bwrk search index' was run. Fix: make search-result loading non-fatal (catch + warn like the other sub-loaders) so a stale index degrades one panel, not the whole console.
acceptanceCriteria: A stale search index degrades only the search panel, not the whole dataset
Live mode stays live (real ids) when peripheral sub-loaders fail
closedReason: Fixed and verified; merged to main.
